WITH pay_sum AS (
  SELECT order_id AS oid,
         SUM(payment_value) AS order_rev
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
),
ord_cust AS (
  SELECT o.order_id AS oid,
         c.customer_unique_id AS custuid,
         CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS purchase_dt,
         COALESCE(ps.order_rev, 0.0) AS order_rev
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN pay_sum ps ON o.order_id = ps.oid
),
cust_agg AS (
  SELECT custuid,
         COUNT(oid) AS total_orders,
         MIN(purchase_dt) AS first_order_date,
         MAX(purchase_dt) AS last_order_date,
         SUM(order_rev) AS total_revenue,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(oid) > 0 THEN SUM(order_rev) / COUNT(oid) ELSE NULL END AS avg_order_value,
         date_diff('day', MIN(purchase_dt), MAX(purchase_dt)) AS lifetime_days
  FROM ord_cust
  GROUP BY custuid
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_unique_customers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN total_orders > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_repeat_customers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN total_orders > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS repeat_purchase_rate,
  AVG(total_orders) AS avg_orders_per_customer,
  median(total_orders) AS median_orders_per_customer,
  AVG(lifetime_days) AS average_customer_lifetime_days
FROM cust_agg;
